summary: Practice risk where sold properties are selectively adjusted to sale price while unsold properties are not similarly reviewed, potentially invalidating ratio studies and creating inequity.
plain_language: Sales chasing is treating sold properties differently just because they sold.

relationships.note: Can bias sale sample and ratio study.
Selective treatment can create unequal assessment.
IAAO standard discusses sales validation and study integrity.

source_refs.locator: sales validation and ratio study integrity

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, Title 350 Chapter 12 index entry.
